findings.defect: Reviewer view omitted report peers and historical comparison context, so target quality/reference results differed from owner views.
findings.fix: Run the existing unified effective-context validation on the server for the authorized target. Only target issues and its reference result enter the response. Contextual issue explanations are generic; peer and prior report values, names, dates, identities and links are not rendered or granted.

findings.defect: Each reviewer correction form submitted only one field, omitted resolved_issues and immediately completed the task.
findings.fix: One reviewer correction form supports explicitly selected multiple fields and granular reviewed issue checkboxes before a single terminal service submission. Unselected inputs are ignored. Confirmation and correction share explanation/issue controls; non-reviewable unit/date/source restrictions remain enforced by the existing service.
findings.browser_validation: Actual browser selected result and date changes and recognition_uncertain before completion.

findings.defect: Repeated source authorization used a cached reviewer object after rendering.
findings.fix: Reload the reviewer account from the database before final exact-task authorization so active/staff state and permission caches cannot survive deactivation or permission removal during rendering.

findings.fix: Render effective standard name/code and the current automatic standard name/code. Before/after history includes both mapping identities alongside raw text, values, units and dates.

limits: Full phase-two suite, independent code review, real sample evaluation, PostgreSQL concurrency and final release evidence are root-owned and are not claimed by this task report.

Effective reads currently perform per-observation resolver/validation queries and resolve patient rows before Python filtering/pagination. Large-history response time and query-volume optimization have not been benchmarked.

Within one uploaded document, distinct known exam dates produce separate columns. Distinct exams on the same date cannot be assigned separate identities without additional extraction context; all duplicate values remain visible and are never averaged or discarded.
Browser evidence uses synthetic documents and isolated roles. It does not establish real-report parsing accuracy or external browser/device compatibility.
Per-page date/method extraction and persistence are being integrated by root; this task verifies the read contract using persisted effective dates and methods.
